```{r}
#| include: false
library(apaTables)
```

## Results

A rotated table, then an UPRIGHT one, then a rotated one. Floats keep document
order when they are moved to the end, so this is the arrangement Phase 1.14's
adjacency check exists for: the two rotated tables are NOT consecutive, and
merging them would put the upright table inside the landscape section, where it
would print rotated.

`landscape-caption-run.qmd` cannot see this -- its upright table comes LAST, so
no rotated float ever follows one and the adjacency branch never runs. Deleting
that branch left the whole suite green until this fixture existed.

`tbl-inta`: rotated.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-inta
#| tbl-cap: "CAPTIONINTA"
#| echo: false
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(apa.cor.table(mtcars))
```

`tbl-intb`: NOT rotated -- it sits BETWEEN the two rotated tables.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-intb
#| tbl-cap: "CAPTIONINTB"
#| echo: false
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(
  apa.1way.table(iv = dose, dv = libido, data = viagra))
```

`tbl-intc`: rotated.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-intc
#| tbl-cap: "CAPTIONINTC"
#| echo: false
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(apa.cor.table(mtcars[, 1:9]))
```
